analyticCertificate: With q=p-1>0 and x=1/(pn), (1-x)^(-q)>=1+qx implies the displayed tail inequality. The auxiliary sequence tends to zero because its logarithm is at most minus (1/p) times a divergent harmonic partial sum. Tonelli handles the nonnegative sum reversal. Every truncated sharpness sequence has finite p sum, and the integral comparison asymptotic yields the harmonic weighted-average limit. This shares the broad theme of sharp mean inequalities with Carleman, but the central power-space Holder operator estimate differs from weighted geometric AM-GM.
